verdict: Passed the stated preservation, six-state pants self / pants-ankle checks, 63 sampled pants self / pants-ankle checks, and new outsole closure checks. Not a full-character, all-motion, all-object-pairs clearance.
retained_limits: Separate shoe upper, rim and new outsole plate surfaces overlap at their assembly seams.
Generated ankle and instep remain separate surfaces with a visible contact seam in the stress side view.
63 samples are discrete path samples, not a proof for every intermediate time or arbitrary animation.
Coat/waist contact and original hand defects are not re-certified or repaired by this review.
Lip-expression appearance and GLB serialization are reviewed separately.
